caption: A hat on a mannequin head is turned from side to side in front of a shop mirror, and the reflection turns in mirror image.

sa.check: A hat is on a mannequin head in front of a shop mirror.
The reflection turns in mirror image.
The turning is from side to side.
The head turns first and the reflection turns with it.

pc.expect: The reflection turns at the same time as the head.
pc.fail: It turns first or later; or it stays still while the head turns; or it turns while the head is still.

pc.expect: The reflection turns to the mirrored side, facing the real head across the surface, wearing the same hat.
pc.fail: It turns the same way as a rotated copy would; or it wears a different hat; or it shows the back of the head.

pc.expect: The reflection does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It shifts while the head is still; or slides across the mirror.

pc.expect: The mirror is flat and rigid: the reflection is undistorted.
pc.fail: The surface ripples; or the reflection warps; or the mirror bends.

pc.expect: One head, one hat and one reflection; the reflection stays in the mirror.
pc.fail: A second head appears; or the reflection steps out; or the hat vanishes; or the head passes into the glass.

pc.expect: The hat's colour and the shop stay the same.
pc.fail: The hat changes colour; or the frame changes; or the shop rearranges.

note: Mirror geometry: each point of the image lies directly across the mirror surface from the real point, so the image is a mirror copy, not a rotated one. The hand turning the head is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
